expectations.Cloudshift: Same selected nontoken card, exile then return under our control; new game object.
expectations.Momentary Blink: Same selected nontoken card, exile then return under owner control; flashback separate.
expectations.Oblivion Ring: Separate triggers: departure before entry resolution returns nothing, then exile still occurs. Native presence guard contradicts this.
expectations.Banisher Priest: Duration return, not independent return trigger. Native extra trigger raises timing fidelity concern.

source.name: Cloudshift
source.oracle_text: Exile target creature you control, then return that card to the battlefield under your control.

source.name: Banisher Priest
source.oracle_text: When this creature enters, exile target creature an opponent controls until this creature leaves the battlefield.

source.name: Momentary Blink
source.oracle_text:
Exile target creature you control, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.
Flashback {3}{U} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)

source.name: Oblivion Ring
source.oracle_text:
When this enchantment enters, exile another target nonland permanent.
When this enchantment leaves the battlefield, return the exiled card to the battlefield under its owner's control.
